integrity: The algebra identity, Nijenhuis torsion, automorphism group, finite-field counts, rank profile, and Rota-Baxter sublocus are reconstructed directly. Finite-field enumeration is replay evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one normalized two-dimensional specialization of Example 1.3, not the full family.
The automorphism group is trivial, so conjugacy adds no orbit compression.
title: Nijenhuis operators on a canonical two-dimensional anti-flexible algebra
